title: Ubupfapfa bw'Imbaraga Nkuru
intro: Tangira urugendo rwo kuvumbura imiterere y’umuryango w’abantu bagize imigambi y’ubutwari bashoje iherezo ritunguranye kandi rikomeye. Iyi nkuru itwibutsa imbaraga z’Imana n’ubudahangarwa bw’imbaraga z’isi iyo zirwanya ibyera. Sobanura ibanga ry’iri tsinda, inkuru yaryo yanditswe muri Korowani nk'umuburo ku bantu bose bashaka kurenga ku mategeko.
clues: Twari dufite intego ikomeye, twizera ko imbaraga zacu ntagereranywa, maze dutangira urugendo dufite intego isobanutse kandi irimbuza.
Umuyobozi wacu, wuzuye ubwibone, yashatse kwanduza Ingoro ndende yubahwaga na benshi, agamije guhindura urugendo rutagatifu ajya mu nyubako twubatse natwe.
Twavuye mu gihugu cya kure, twagiye n'ingabo nyinshi, twizeye ubushobozi bwacu bwo gusenya inyubako ya kera yari mu Murwa Mutagatifu.
Ingabo zacu zari zikomeye, ziyobowe n'ibiremwa bitangaje, ikintu cyagaragaye gake cyane, niba cyarigeze kibaho, mu rugamba nk'urwo n'abaturage bo mu gihugu twateye.
Tugeze aho twajyaga, Imana yadufashije; ibiremwa bito bifite amababa byaraduteye amabuye y'ibumba ryatekeshejwe.
Urugendo rwacu rwose rwahuye n’iherezo ribi cyane, risiga ingabo zacu zikomeye zitsembwe burundu, nk’ibyatsi byatawe, umugambi wacu ukomeye uhinduka ivumbi.
arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
verse: Have you not considered, [O Muḥammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant? (105:1)
